stem: Find the set of zeroes of the function $f(x)=x^2-2x+1$. Tap on the number line every value of $x$ for which $f(x)=0$.
solution: Set the factor equal to zero: $x-1=0$, so $x=1$.

hints.text: Check whether your factorised form can be zero for any value of $x$, by setting its factor equal to 0.
Substitute each value you marked into $f(x)$; it is a zero only if $f(x)$ comes out as 0.
Solve the factor equal to 0 again, carefully: in $x-a=0$, what must $x$ be?
